children: Shares of Asset Reconstruction Company (India) (ASSR.NS), the country's first asset reconstruction firm to go public, fell 2.5% in their trading debut on Thursday, after opening flat to their IPO price, following its 7.33 billion-rupee($76.31 million) IPO.
The stock was trading at 135.61 rupees as of 10:15 am IST, after opening at its issue price of 139 rupees on the National Stock Exchange of India.
